title: Rioproperty laws
description: A big capital heading and a violet sub-head over a three-column grid of short rules: each a violet line with a grey follow-up, separated by pale hairlines that draw in (across under each rule, down between the columns) as the grid scrolls through, while the words of every line ripple up out of masks. Phones show the first six in one column with a centred 'more' toggle for the rest.
notes: the phone toggle is a plain checkbox (CSS :has), no JavaScript
a multiple of three rules fills the desktop grid evenly
